_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (Tables 1, 4, 5, 7), kept verbatim for reference. They come from ScanNet++/ETH3D/NeRF-Synthetic/Tanks-and-Temples with full-scale NeRF, 3DGS and SVRaster backbones and are not on this gym's scale; they are not scored.

uncertainty_ause_table1.description: Paper Table 1: AUSE evaluation on ScanNet++ and ETH3D. Lower is better.

scannetpp_ause.description: Area under the sparsification error curve on ScanNet++.

eth3d_ause.description: Area under the sparsification error curve on ETH3D.

active_view_nerf_synthetic_10_table4.description: Paper Table 4: active view selection for novel view synthesis on NeRF Synthetic with 10 selected views.

psnr.description: Novel-view image fidelity measured by peak signal-to-noise ratio.

selected_views.description: Number of selected camera views used by the active-view procedure.

backbone_changed.description: Indicator that the fixed rendering backbone was changed.

active_view_tanks_temples_table5.description: Paper Table 5: active view selection for novel view synthesis on Tanks and Temples with SVRaster.

psnr.description: Novel-view image fidelity measured by peak signal-to-noise ratio.

selected_views.description: Number of selected camera views used by the active-view procedure.

backbone_changed.description: Indicator that the fixed rendering backbone was changed.

active_mapping_3dgs_table7.description: Paper Table 7: active mapping with 3DGS on Tanks and Temples. F1 score is higher better.

mean_f1.description: Mean reconstruction F1 score across active-mapping scenes.

selected_views.description: Number of selected camera views used by the active-mapping procedure.

backbone_changed.description: Indicator that the fixed reconstruction backbone was changed.

depth_uncertainty_sparse.description: Pixel-wise depth uncertainty of a radiance field trained on 3 views, scored by AUSE against the held-out ground-truth depth error (paper Eq. 2 rendered depth) on 6 target views per hidden scene (scaled analogue of paper Table 1). Lower AUSE is better.

ause.description: Area under the sparsification error curve of target-view depth error ordered by predicted uncertainty (paper protocol), averaged over target views.

spearman_depth_error.description: Spearman rank correlation between predicted uncertainty and true depth error, averaged over target views.

depth_uncertainty_sparse.notes: Scaled setting generated by this gym (56 hidden procedural scenes, 48x48 tiny NeRF, paper Eq. 2 depth); values are the reference method's and the evaluator baselines' hidden-test scores from the final build, not paper numbers.

depth_uncertainty_dense.description: Same depth-uncertainty measurement for a radiance field trained on 8 views spread around the scene (closest to the paper's Table 1 protocol of alternating train/test views).

ause.description: Area under the sparsification error curve of target-view depth error ordered by predicted uncertainty (paper protocol), averaged over target views.

spearman_depth_error.description: Spearman rank correlation between predicted uncertainty and true depth error, averaged over target views.

depth_uncertainty_dense.notes: Scaled setting generated by this gym (56 hidden procedural scenes, 48x48 tiny NeRF, paper Eq. 2 depth); values are the reference method's and the evaluator baselines' hidden-test scores from the final build, not paper numbers.

active_view_selection.description: Sequential active view selection (scaled analogue of paper Tables 2-7): from 3 initial views, acquire 2 of 16 candidate views one at a time, continuing radiance-field training after each acquisition; candidates and the 32 held-out views are drawn from the same pose law, as in the paper's benchmarks. Scores novel-view quality and geometry of the final field on the 32 held-out views.

final_psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) of the final field's renderings of the 32 held-out evaluation views.

final_ssim.description: Mean SSIM of the final field's renderings of the 32 held-out evaluation views.

final_depth_mae.description: Mean absolute camera-z depth error (paper Eq. 2 depth) of the final field on the 32 held-out evaluation views (reconstruction quality, the active-mapping analogue).

active_view_selection.notes: Scaled setting generated by this gym (56 hidden procedural scenes, 48x48 tiny NeRF, paper Eq. 2 depth); values are the reference method's and the evaluator baselines' hidden-test scores from the final build, not paper numbers. Final quality of every ordered acquisition pair (240 per scene) is precomputed with one fixed backbone recipe, so no method retrains anything.
